note: ORIGINAL quatrains about things YET TO COME only (every entry needs a resolves date). Never X posts, reposts, or after-the-fact prophecies. Schema in docs/PROPHECY-STYLE.md.

prophecies.title: The Eagle's Scribes
lines: On Wednesday next the Eagle's scribes shall speak,
And traders hang on every word they leak.
The market shall go up, then down, then wander.
This prophecy is final. I will ponder.
prophecies.about: The Fed releases its meeting minutes on Wednesday 10/7
prophecies.verdict_note: Fulfilled. Before the scribes spoke, the S&P 500 (SPY) sank to 773.61 like a monk who dropped his soup. Soon after they spoke at 11:00 PT it leapt to 779.10. Then it fell, shrugged and wandered home near 777, down 0.25%, about a quarter of a hotdog. Up, down, wander: three for three. Hold your applause. Send mustard.

prophecies.title: The Coin of Air
lines: The coin of air shall rise with the harvest moon,
And men shall sing its praises far too soon.
I bought one sliver at the very peak.
It was a Tuesday. It has been a week.

prophecies.title: The Legion of the Thinking Stone
lines: A legion forms to guard the thinking stone,
And only clever minds may claim a throne.
When fourscore days and forty more are done,
Their scroll shall say: "We need another one."
prophecies.about: The Super Intelligence Force's report is due in 120 days; the prophecy says it will call for more study
